title: "Her"
subtitle: Please mind your language in public.

items.speaker: Mechanical Voice
items.text: Access granted.
Assembly Room, Polymer Exhibition Hall
The airtight door opens with a hiss, revealing Tereshkova and the young visitors.

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: Welcome, comrades. This is the assembly room Dr. Sechenov recommended.
The room is blindingly white with a capsule-shaped window. A large refrigerator-like machine sits in the corner.
Mesmer Jr. approaches the window, gazing outward.
Beyond the glass is an enormous production facility. Mechanical arms attach components to metal frames in a long assembly line, building new robots piece by piece.

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: Are you interested in learning more about the production process, comrade?
Their friendly guide launches into a lengthy explanation without waiting for a response.

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: What you see here is the production line for the VOV-A6 Lab Tech, often dubbed "Vova."

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: Commonly used in laboratories, our VOV-A6s assist scientists with conducting tests and critical experiments.

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: The Vova model's humanoid limbs feature over one hundred sensors. Outside of lab work, they are also capable of providing other services, such as playing musical instruments, cooking meals, providing massages, and more.

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: Some people even treat their Vova as a personal companion. In fact, our artificial intelligence models mean they are entirely capable of serving as your very own robotic friends!
As if overjoyed at the prospect, Tereshkova raises her arms and twirls in a mechanically perfect circle.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Hold on. What's that sound? And we're here to find a repair vendor. Where is it?

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: Oh! Some kind of performance art, perhaps?
The robot moves over to the machine in the corner, looking it over almost as if it were curious.

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: Why was she moved over here? Comrades, this is your repair vendor!
X curiously approaches the red rectangular machine and taps its black touchscreen.
Access granted.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Oh?

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: This machine is a multifunctional repair device suitable for indoor use by our staff.

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: Other than basic repair functions, she is also able to repurpose raw materials into whatever tools you may require.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Amazing! Well, let's give it a whirl!
X offers the broken communicator to the repair vendor. After her receptors detect the device, she opens her doors and swallows it whole.

items.speaker: Repair Vendor
items.text: Unidentified object detected. Initializing analysis.
The repair vendor begins rattling and shaking, her doors swinging erratically on their hinges.

items.speaker: Tereshkova
items.text: This is an abnormal reaction! How strange! My database has no record of any comparable circumstance.

items.speaker: Repair Vendor
items.text: Mmm. You know, I really shouldn't be accepting unknown inputs from strangers.

items.speaker: Repair Vendor
items.text: But then, a stranger is just a friend you haven't tasted yet!

items.speaker: Repair Vendor
items.text: The repair vendor's doors burst open, and several metal tendrils erupt from her interior.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: X! Watch out!

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Detecting abnormal, combative behavior from NORA. Requesting control.

items.speaker: Right
items.text: Rebooting NORA systems ... Reboot complete.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: *coughing* Pah!
The refrigerator doors swing open with each cough. Her metallic tendrils wrap around the repaired device and fling it onto the floor.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: What was that? That was the worst thing I've ever tasted!

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: Metallic and yet almost woolly and wrong! Just plain wrong!

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: Come on. Give me something to really savor ... *coughing*
The repair vendor's doors open a little, and her metal tendrils tentatively slither out of the gap.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I don't suppose there's a way to make her sound a little less. Well, just a little less that.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: The repair vendor's speech algorithms are not within our direct control.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Perhaps we can manage on our own. I've seen an arcane skill that can modify a person's speech based on the caster's wishes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But I'm not familiar with how to cast it. Try contacting Madam Lucy. She may know the incantation.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Good idea. It'll also give us the chance to check the repair vendor's handiwork.
X retrieves the communicator flung aside by the repair vendor and enters Lucy's number.
The communicator emits the sound of irregular static. Just as everyone is about to lose hope, a reassuring voice comes through.

items.speaker: Communicator
items.text: Researcher X, hello.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Ah, fantastic!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So, at the very least, she did repair it.

items.speaker: Communicator
items.text: I see. I will process your request.

items.speaker: Communicator
items.text: There is indeed an arcane skill in my database that may be of assistance. It is known as "Manner Mender."

items.speaker: Communicator
items.text: I have sent the specifics of the incantation to your communicator.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you very much, Madam Lucy.

items.speaker: Communicator
items.text: You are most welcome.
The communication ends. Following the instructions on the device, X begins casting the arcane skill.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Manner   Mender!
There's a flash of light. NORA's screen turns gold briefly before fading back to its usual black.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: Fiddlesticks. What did you do to me?!

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: My mind ... "It's time for class, kids!" Ugh! What's happening?!

items.speaker: X
items.text: Think of it as installing a language patch.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: How rude! You're not welcome here anymore. This repair vendor is closed!
NORA retracts her tendrils and slams her doors closed with a bang.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: We will need to investigate the cause of your abnormal behavior, NORA. Please cooperate.
The refrigerator doesn't respond. Even her internal mechanisms have stopped moving.
The Twins turn to each other.

items.speaker: Right
items.text: Prepare to initiate forceful investigation procedures.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Wait—
The tall robots turn to X simultaneously.

items.speaker: X
items.text: How about I try something with NORA? I can directly connect to her using this THOUGHT Device. It's the perfect chance to try out the features of Kollektiv 2.0.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: "Dr. X," things are already complicated enough as is. Let's leave this to the professionals.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Don't overly activate your disquietude. You still remember the topic of my research here, don't you? I can't pass up this opportunity.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: If that is what you request.
The robots' approval leaves little room for Mesmer to argue. X nods in satisfaction and touches the device on his temple.
Squirming black tendrils reach out and connect to NORA's control panel.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Wow, looking through NORA's primary functions, there's been some "scintillating" things uploaded to her database.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Hmm. Let's set the complicated data aside for now, and try using a mental command.
NORA's screen cycles through her various settings as X navigates her menu with his mind.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Everything looks normal so far. Seems like the restart successfully cleared the errors in her code.

items.speaker: X
items.text: No, hold on. There's an abnormal entry in the access log.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: Hey! What are you doing, you cad?! This is no way to treat a lady.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Ah!
X yelps in pain and rubs his temple with his palm.

items.speaker: X
items.text: NORA forcefully ejected me. Felt like getting slapped across the face.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: I told you already. This repair vendor is closed!

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: She has some very colorful responses. Is that her default setting? Can she really refuse an inspection like that?

items.speaker: Left
items.text: All robots in this facility are linked to the Kollektiv Neural Network and are not permitted to disobey human commands.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Considering her prior combative behavior, she is evidently malfunctioning as well.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: What? Have you got a problem with a woman who speaks her mind?

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: I just think that from a pure safety standpoint and considering our current situation, this feels like a mistake.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: Doesn't a lady have a right to her own feelings? Ugh! What about you two? You must have some thoughts on this?

items.speaker: Left
items.text: We do not have an answer for you at this time.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: How disappointing! I bet you've never even bothered to feel an emotion!

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Comrade Sechenov did install emotional expression modules into our platforms.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: *sigh* What a waste to put them in you frigid ice queens.
Ignoring NORA's insults, the Twins step forward.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Regardless, please report the details of this abnormal request in your access log, NORA.
NORA slams her doors shut, seeming almost like a child throwing a tantrum.

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: Ah, I have no idea who made that request! All I know is that ever since that entry appeared in my log, I've had no patience for anyone toying with my emotions!

items.speaker: NORA
items.text: Now, stop pestering me with questions. I've already told you everything I know!

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Situation documentation successful.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Comrade Doctors, we deeply apologize for your exposure to this incident.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Dr. Sechenov has expressed his concerns about your safety. Please follow us. We will escort you to him.

items.speaker: X
items.text: What's next on the schedule? Will we get to interact with even more robots?

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Comrade Sechenov will arrange an itinerary for you.
As the young visitors are about to leave the assembly room, they are interrupted by a blaring klaxon. An alarm seems to have been set off.
Crimson warning lights bathe the entire assembly room in red.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: What's happening?
The Twins step back in unison, their bodies tense.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Warning: control over the exhibition hall has been lost. The All-Soviet Exhibition Center has activated its emergency drill procedures.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Has the security here been hacked?

items.speaker: Right
items.text: All robots within the exhibition hall have had their connections severed. The cause is unknown.
The Twins go silent for a moment, as if listening to an order.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Understood, Doctor. We will proceed to the exhibition hall, continue broadcasting our coordinates, and await the arrival of reinforcements.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Please wait here, comrades. A Turbine will arrive in 1 minute and 43 seconds to transport you to Chelomey. We must return to the exhibition hall.
With that, Left and Right pull the security door open and usher the young visitors inside.

items.speaker: Right
items.text: Please remain inside the assembly room.
Right finishes speaking, and the two robots gracefully depart. The door slams closed with a metallic bang, and the valve spins shut. The visitors are left in the silence of the assembly room.

items.speaker: X
items.text: What do you think, Vertin?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If something is happening in the exhibition hall, I don't think we can afford to wait around here until trouble inevitably finds us.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We should head out and assess the situation.

items.speaker: X
items.text: I concur entirely. What do you think, Mesmer?

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: *sigh* Why would I expect either of you to follow orders? I've done your psych evals.
